doc.name: Daystruct Evidence Agent
doc.description: Public read-only access to retained provenance-backed AI infrastructure and software evidence. The refinery was paused on 2026-09-25; observations are no longer refreshed. This legacy interface returns evidence and uncertainty, not actions or capability acquisition. Discover the current capability marketplace through REST or MCP.

skills.name: Read Daystruct evidence
skills.description: Search entities, inspect canonical facts and provenance, read context-packet contracts, resolve software questions, and read recent evidence changes.
examples: Does this package support this API?

skills.name: Resolve a stated situation
skills.description: Answer a question about a concrete situation rather than returning evidence to interpret: which known vulnerabilities affect the version you are running, whether a release line is still supported as of today, and which models meet a stated need and budget. Anything that cannot be determined is returned as undetermined rather than omitted, so an unanswered case never reads as a clear one.
examples: I am running vLLM 0.11.2, what affects me?
Which reasoning model under $1 per million input tokens has at least a 128k context?
